caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bench placed centrally against a plain, neutral-colored background. The bench is composed of brown wood with visible grain patterns and consists of a tall, slightly angled backrest, a flat seat, and two armrests on either side. The bench also has wide, sturdy legs with a rounded arch cut out at the bottom of each leg. The wood’s surface is smooth with gentle curves at the tops of the armrests, and the bench includes small, round metal fasteners visible on the side panels. The overall form is angular, with straight lines dominating the design except for the slight curves on the side panels and seat supports. The colors in the image consist mainly of shades of brown and tan, with shadows and highlights used to suggest depth and the three-dimensional shape of the bench, while the background remains plain and undecorated.
title: Settle-table
